body:
FOR WHOEVER BUILDS THIS (server code and tests read 6 Nov 2026, main 068c71a; B-38's row has the proof, this has the handles).

THE LINE: `LeanResolver.resolve_ranked` (sources/youtube/lean.py:217-229) catches `DownloadError, FutureTimeout, OSError, ...` and, with no fallback, raises `DownloadError("unavailable", ...)`. Production builds it without a fallback (sources/youtube/source.py:56), so every search hiccup becomes "unavailable".

WHY THE CODE IS WHAT DECIDES: three consumers read the code, and only the codes in `_REST` retry.
 * Keeper: `GIVE_UP["unavailable"]` (keeper/keeper.py:34-37) ends the keep for good; `_REST = {blocked, timeout, slow}` (line 40) is the retry list (300 to 900 s).
 * Imports: `ImportService.match` (imports/service.py:303-310) retries only `_REST` codes; any other `DownloadError` sets `video = None` and the entry becomes `not_found` for good. So the fix must be a `_REST` code (`timeout`), not a new one, or this consumer needs its list changed too.
 * A tap: `_stream_error` (api.py:829-840) maps `unavailable` to `song_unavailable/removed` and a `timeout` to `source_unreachable` (retryable). Only `slow` becomes `upstream_timeout`.

THE FIX, with one catch: the `except` also catches a `DownloadError` raised inside `_resolve` and replaces its code. Re-raise a `DownloadError` you already have (a `blocked` keeps its rest meaning) and convert only the non-`DownloadError` failures to `timeout`.

THE TEST THAT PINS THE BUG: tests/sources/test_lean.py:236 `test_without_a_fallback_the_failure_is_an_honest_error_not_not_found` asserts `code == "unavailable"`. It must change to `timeout`; add the one test per consumer that B-38 asks for (tests/test_keeper.py: stays queued with a reason, not failed; tests/test_imports.py: the entry stays pending and the item retries, not `not_found`; the route test for the tap). The fallback tests in the same class (lines 225-250) pass because they inject a fallback that production never has.

DECISION TO MAKE VISIBLE: the `fallback=` parameter is dead in production. Do not wire it in this item (it is the slow yt-dlp search: more YouTube load, docs/09). Either keep it as a documented option or delete it with its tests (rule 1: a defence nobody runs reads as protection). Say which in the PR.

DOCS in the same PR: docs/33 (the failure matrix: a search timeout), docs/17 error list (no new code).
REPEAT: `python -X utf8 docs/evidence/scripts/audit_probes.py transient` (in-process, nothing sent) and, on a real stack, `audit_stack.py check transient` (docs/evidence/README.md#d01). Done when the probe's last line matches its "wanted" line.
